usage: cox route remove [-h] --reason REASON [--by BY] [--dry-run] [--profile PROFILE] id

positional arguments:
  id                 a queued intake or an initiative

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --reason REASON
  --by BY            who removes; default the OS user
  --dry-run          print the plan and write nothing
  --profile PROFILE
